question: In classical music, who was placed on leave until September 30, 2026, by the Salzburg Festival on March 26, 2026?

steps.content:
[Salzburg Festival Fires Its Artistic Director - The New York Times] March 27, 2026 - “Due to irreconcilable differences of opinion, the Salzburg Festival and Artistic Director Markus Hinterhäuser have decided to part ways, effective immediately,” the festival’s supervisory board said in a statement.
[Breaking: Salzburg Festival chief is gone - Slippedisc] March 26, 2026 - March 26, 2026 · The artistic director of the Salzburg Festival Markus Hinterhäuser has been suspended with immediate effect. He will be on paid leave until the end of September when his contract expires, according to a board statement.
[Salzburg Festival Suspends Artistic Director Markus Hinterhäuser After Ten-Year Tenure] March 27, 2026 - Markus Hinterhäuser, who restored the Salzburg Festival's artistic credibility over a decade of geopolitical turbulence — wars, sanctions, collapsed sponsorships — has been placed on immediate paid leave.

On March 26, 2026, Markus Hinterhäuser, the artistic director of the Salzburg Festival, was placed on leave until September 30, 2026. 

FINAL: Markus Hinterhäuser
